newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fuji Heavy Inds rises on brighter business outlook.
newsitem.headline: Fuji Heavy Inds rises on brighter business outlook.

text.p: Fuji Heavy Industries Ltd shares climbed in the Tuesday morning session, boosted by sentiment that the company's business outlook had improved, brokers said.
As of 0127 GMT, Fuji Heavy's shares were up 10 yen at 590, the most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo bourse with volume of 3.445 million shares.
A broker at a foreign brokerage said that foreign investors are buying the issue on bright earnings prospects for the current and next business years.
Kaoru Kurata, analyst at Goldman Sachs (Japan) Ltd, said the Forester, Fuji's new sport utility vehicle, will begin contributing to the company's earnings from the business year starting in April.
